name: smithers-runs
description: Streams actionable transitions (approval pending, failed, stalled, node retry churn) plus a periodic run-progress still-running digest for the Smithers runs THIS session started or subscribed to; relay every line to the user so a detached run never goes hours without a status. Runs from other sessions and pre-existing runs never notify. Subscriptions are recorded automatically by `smithers claude tick` (the /workflows mirror) and Claude-launched runs, or explicitly via `smithers claude subscribe <runId>`. Completed, failed, and cancelled runs are not broadcast (the /workflows mirror reports those). Exits silently in projects with no Smithers control database.
